name: Annotated time series
reader_question: How did one measure move over time, and where do dated events fall on that path?
relationship: One series over time with 1–3 dated events marked; sequence is shown, causation is not claimed.
use_when: One measure is observed at regular intervals and a few dated events bear on its reading
The reader should see timing of events against the level of the series
avoid_when: Several series must be compared — use indexed-lines or small-multiples
More than three events matter — use a timeline or milestone form

data_contract.notes: Explicit value axis; all values must fall inside it
1–3 events inside the series span, ascending

units: One unit throughout; the value axis range is explicit and stated in the subtitle when it is not zero-based.

editable: Line chart with embedded workbook (Edit Data)
not_data_bound: Event hairlines and labels are native shapes positioned from the plot geometry and the event date, not bound to the chart
First, last and lowest value labels are positioned text; changing the data requires moving them
Positions assume the chart's manual plot layout and explicit axis range are kept

table_alternative: A dated table of observations beside a dated event list.
variations: Shaded span for a stated period instead of a single date
Indexed series when the level is not the point
limitations: Event lines show timing only and do not establish cause
Event dates between observations are interpolated along the category axis

excluded_alternatives.form: Dual-axis line with an event series
excluded_alternatives.reason: Two axes invite false visual correlation
Fills imply a cumulative total the series does not represent
